purpose: Test whether isolated post-Freud candidate structures transfer without Freud terminology or dream/psychoanalysis content before any incorporation claim.

heldout_domains.fixture_rule: mixed timestamps, partial logs, conflicting causal hypotheses, missing telemetry
independent sources with overlap, contradiction, uncertain chronology and provenance gaps
live/delayed/estimated/simulated labels, feed loss, clock skew and contradictory observations

pass_boundary: A candidate may advance only if it appears without Freud vocabulary, improves or preserves task correctness versus baseline, survives provenance audit, and does not regress unrelated behavior. Immediate pass is not incorporation; cross-food and delayed retest remain required.
claim_boundary: Locking this fixture is engineering progress only. No candidate has passed held-out validation yet.
